en.title: PlayStation Plus December: Tony Hawk, Dragon Ball, and Amnesia Hit PS Plus
en.summary: Sony has officially revealed December's PlayStation Plus Monthly Games lineup, featuring a beloved skateboarding classic, a fan-favorite anime fighter, and a tense horror experience. Subscribers can snag these titles starting December 1st.
en.body:
Get ready to shred, fight, and hide, PlayStation fans! Sony has just dropped the official lineup for December's PlayStation Plus Monthly Games, and it's a triple threat of genre-spanning fun. From December 1st through January 4th, subscribers can download **Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3+4**, **Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2**, and **Amnesia: The Bunker** to their PS4 and PS5 consoles.

This is a welcome return for the iconic skateboarding franchise, with **Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3+4** promising to bring back that addictive combo-driven gameplay. IGN’s review at the time praised the series’ timeless formula, noting, "Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3 + 4 proves yet again the series’ over-the-top skateboarding formula is totally timeless, even if some of the changes to THPS4 miss the mark and the soundtrack has been fumbled." The PS5 version is also set to offer a slick experience, running at native 4K and 60FPS in its Fidelity Mode, ensuring smooth tricks and grinds.

## A Fighter, A Skater, and a Survivor

Joining the lineup is **Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2**, a title that has maintained a dedicated following since its 2017 release. This fighting game offers a deep dive into the Dragon Ball universe, allowing players to create their own characters and engage in epic battles. IGN’s review highlighted its ambition, stating, "Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 is an ambitious, if rough-edged experience, with deceptively deep RPG and brawling elements." For those looking for a more atmospheric and terrifying experience, **Amnesia: The Bunker** offers a chilling descent into survival horror. Praised for its claustrophobic design and emergent gameplay, it's a strong addition for fans of the genre.

## What the Lineup Means for Players

With the massive success of titles like **Grand Theft Auto VI** dominating many players' attention spans, these PlayStation Plus additions offer a fantastic opportunity to explore different experiences without additional cost. Whether you're looking for a blast from the past with Tony Hawk, a chance to master Kamehamehas in Dragon Ball, or to test your nerve against unseen horrors in Amnesia, there’s something here for everyone. It’s also a crucial reminder for PlayStation Plus members to claim November’s titles – **Dead Island 2**, **Tomb Raider IV – VI Remastered**, and **Monster Train 2** – before they disappear on November 30th.

## What's Next

Mark your calendars: these three exciting titles will be available to download for PlayStation Plus subscribers from December 1st, 2026, until January 4th, 2027. Make sure to add them to your library during this window to play them anytime as long as your subscription is active.
